name: Test first: approved tests, then the code that passes them
description: A test writer writes the tests, a person approves them, and the implementer starts from them: they are frozen on its branch, so it can read them but not change them. The final gate shows the evidence; on approval a tool node opens the pull request.

steps.instructions: Write one failing test for each acceptance criterion in the request, named with its id, in test files only, and commit them.

steps.title: Approve these tests?
steps.prompt: Approving freezes the tests: the implementer can read them but not change them.

steps.instructions: Make the approved tests pass without changing them, and commit.

steps.title: Open a pull request?
steps.prompt: Approving pushes the implementer's branch, with the approved tests, and opens a pull request.

args.title: Implement the feature
args.body: Tests approved first, then the code that passes them.
